question: Which is India’s biggest football stadium?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Salt Lake City Stadium**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Salt Lake City Stadium**

 
 
• Salt Lake City Stadium, also known as the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan, is a multi-purpose stadium located in Kolkata, India.
 
• It's one of the largest football stadiums in India, with a capacity of 120,000.
 
• The stadium has hosted numerous significant football matches, including international friendlies and Indian Super League matches.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium**

 
 
• Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium is a multi-purpose sports complex located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It's the largest cricket ground in India by seating capacity, accommodating over 66,000 spectators.
 
• The stadium has hosted numerous cricket matches, including several Cricket World Cups. It's also used for football, hockey, and other sporting events.
 
 
 
• **Chandrasekharan Nair Stadium**
 
 
• Chandrasekharan Nair Stadium, also known as CSN Police Stadium, is located in Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India.
 
• It's primarily used for football matches and has a capacity of 25,000 spectators.
 
• The stadium has hosted various football tournaments and matches, including the Santosh Trophy and Federation Cup.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi Stadium**
 
 
• Indira Gandhi Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium located in New Delhi, India.
 
• It's primarily used for cricket matches and has a capacity of 66,666 spectators.
 
• The stadium has hosted numerous cricket matches, including international matches and Indian Premier League matches. It's also used for football, hockey, and other sporting events.
